images.label: Clean Panel
images.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high fidelity redesign concept for PLAYER FRAMES ONLY in an existing Thai Pok Deng browser game. Create a single landscape 16:9 polished UI presentation, no browser chrome, no full game board, no betting controls. Backdrop must be a plain smooth dark forest-green gradient #174d37 to #071f18 matching the current app, no fabric texture, no gold ornamental background, no oval table, no lanterns. Show three large legible player frames in one horizontal row centered on canvas, same design family: normal opponent, gold dealer, mint-accented local player. Small unobtrusive English heading at top, short labels above frames 'OPPONENT', 'DEALER', 'YOU'. Each frame has a small circular illustrated anime avatar, a clear player name and role badge at top, chip balance prominently placed, cream playing cards, and a dedicated full-width footer with intact single-line Thai hand label and outcome aligned separately. No text over cards. Generous internal padding, balanced proportions, no wasted tall empty space, practical responsive frontend layout. Normal frame: player name 'มะลิ', balance '1,000' and small 'แต้ม', two cards 7 clubs and A hearts, footer '8 แต้ม · 1 เด้ง'. Dealer frame: name 'ไผ่', role 'เจ้ามือ', balance '1,000 แต้ม', two cards 9 spades and K diamonds, footer 'ป๊อก 9 · 1 เด้ง'. Local player frame: name 'Game', badge 'คุณ', balance '1,000 แต้ม', three cards J hearts, J clubs, K diamonds, footer exactly 'สามเหลือง · 3 เด้ง' with separate outcome 'ชนะ +150'. Thai special-hand label must remain on one line, large and readable. Face values and suits accurate and visually separated. Cream text, emerald surfaces, subtle warm gold and soft mint accents only; avoid blue/purple/neon casino excess, photoreal table objects, 3D perspective, tiny typography, verbose descriptions. Design direction 1: CLEAN PANEL. Heading '01 / CLEAN PANEL'. Crisp restrained flat UI, 18px rounded rectangles, thin muted green outline for opponent, single fine warm gold border for dealer, single clear mint border for local player. Matte very dark green fills, minimal shadow. Avatar and name form a neat top header, chips below left and cards right, subtle divider above footer. Typography is confident modern sans-serif, sharp accessible hierarchy. Most practical understated option, looks ready to implement in CSS.
